[PREFERENCE] User loves the suggestions provided by the assistant.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended using a combination of Parmigiano-Reggiano and Gruyère cheese for the sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for making the sauce ahead of time, including cooling the mushroom mixture quickly, reheating gently, and adding fresh herbs just before serving.
